note: Filename retained from the V0.2 milestone. Current conventions follow docs/CANONICAL-CONVENTIONS.md.

sources.scope: Region / Branch / Site selection hierarchy; may be derived from the building master when no separate source exists
stable physical building/premises master; atomic analysis identity
business/service identities; transit numbers may move between buildings over time and are not physical identifiers
temporal relationship between service point/transit and physical building/premises; should preserve effective dates
optional building-portion/premises layer for mixed owned/leased tenure or subdivided physical scope
FCA observations and corrective actions attached to physical scope
universal accessibility criteria; unknown/not assessed remains distinct from non-compliance
planned, approved, active or recently completed projects

sources.required_if: leased physical scope exists at premises/occupancy level, or legacy building ownership_type indicates leased/mixed when no premises layer exists
sources.scope: lease and renewal/exit dates for the applicable leased occupancy/premises; never automatically applies to the whole site
flood, safety, regulatory, asbestos and other risks
detention horizon, FCI/BFI, capital constraints, amortization and ownership strategy
structured transcription of qualitative strategic context, intentions, constraints, assumptions and stakeholder signals
CMMS/work order and recurring failure evidence
BIM, GIS, floor/space, imagery and geometry references
